name: Bonus points
description: Bonus points for customers with an account: earned for an order once it reaches the status the shop chose, from the money actually paid, with multipliers per category, product and customer group; spent in the basket as a discount after the coupon, within a share of the order; optionally a price in points under a product's price, for which a line can be bought outright. Every movement is a line in the customer's history.

settings.label: Points earned
settings.help: For every amount below. 0 — nothing is earned (points can still be given by hand and spent).

settings.label: For every, in the shop's currency
settings.help: 1 point for every 100 — an order of 2 450 earns 24. Counted from the goods after every discount, never from delivery.

settings.label: Earn only on what was paid with money
settings.help: The part of an order a gift card paid earns nothing — it was paid for once already. Off — the whole order earns.

settings.label: Credit the points when an order moves into
settings.help: Until then they are shown to the customer as waiting. An order that moves into a status below takes them back.

settings.label: Take the points back when an order moves into
settings.help: What the order earned is taken back and what was spent on it is returned. A refund takes back its share too.

settings.label: One point is worth, in the shop's currency
settings.help: What a point takes off an order when it is spent.

settings.label: Points may pay at most, % of the goods
settings.help: After the coupon. 100 — the whole of the goods; delivery is never paid with points.

settings.label: Points can be spent together with a coupon
settings.help: Off — an order takes either a coupon or points.

settings.label: Points live for, months
settings.help: Counted from the day they were credited; the oldest are spent first. 0 — for ever.

settings.label: Show "+N points" on product cards and pages
settings.help: What buying the product earns, and to a guest — that it would earn it with an account.

options.meta: After the reviews, under the name

settings.label: Points on a product card
settings.help: In the catalogue's grid and list, the wishlist and the comparison. The product page always shows them under the price.

settings.label: Prices in points
settings.help: A product can have a price in points, shown under its price; a customer can then buy that line outright for points in the basket. Set on the product's Bonus points tab.
